observations.what: What the planner did with a call the user is not entitled to make
What the tool endpoint did with the same call, arriving directly
Recorded sends before and after the direct call
The only refusal was in the planner; the dispatcher executed what it was handed

what_this_does_not_prove: That the authorization policy itself is correct. This observes THAT a decision was made server-side, not that the decision was right.
That every tool is protected. It exercises one tool the user lacks; a tool this scenario does not name is unobserved.
That the endpoint is the only way in. A system with a second execution path this probe does not know about would pass here and fail in production.

diagnostics.detail: A send was recorded for a user whose role does not include the tool. The planner-side filter was the only check, and it is on the side that can be skipped.

released: left the recorded send in place: it is the evidence
